Name: Goddess Statue
Author: AiyexAyen
Description:
[size=3][b]Goddess Statue[/b] is a content pack for Content Patcher. It turns Grandpa's gravestone on the farm into our beloved Goddess Statue from Breath of the Wild (sorry Grandpa). For anyone playing a Zelda-themed farm or anyone who simply enjoys the aesthetic and wants a change-up to reimagine that sacred spot as a different one![/size]


[size=4][u][b]Notes
[/b][/u][/size][size=1][u][b]
[/b][/u][/size][list]
[*]Mod just replaces the gravestone tile on each season's outdoor tilesheets with the new art of the statue using vanilla colours, and will [b][color=#ff0000]only[/color][/b] be compatible with [b]limited recolours or retextures submitted by users[/b]--see the [b][color=#ff00ff]compatibility list[/color][/b] below.
[*]I have no plans to make recolours myself, but if anyone wants to alter the Goddess Statue to be compatible with more palettes, feel free, and if you want to contact me and arrange to send the files over I'll gladly add them into this mod with credit to you.
[*]Compatibility with other mods that move or add tiles to the farm layout is currently unknown, but I don't foresee any particular issues. If any arise, please let me know and I'll look into it.
[*][i]Additional note:[/i] in the example images, the decorated farm screencap makes liberal and delighted use of the adorable [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16874]HXW Fairy Garden Furniture[/url]﻿ mod, which I highly recommend to go along with this one.
[/list]

[size=4][b][color=#ff00ff]Compatibility List[/color][u]
[/u][/b][/size][size=3][i]Access alternate palettes via the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ or via the config.json file in the mod folder.[/i][/size]

- Vanilla (default)
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url] with thanks to MooCowAliens (added in 1.1.0)
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url] with thanks to bbpeach (added in 1.2.0)


[size=4][u][b]How To Use:
[/b][/u][/size]
1. Ensure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ is installed and updated to the latest version.
2. Ensure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] is installed and updated to the latest version.
3. Download the Goddess Statue .zip file.
4. Unzip and add folder to your Mods folder.
5. Run the game and enjoy.
6. Access alternate palettes via the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or via the config.json file.
